description: This file defines the ProspectLink class, which extends Link2, and customizes the getJoin method to modify how joins are constructed for campaign target list relations in SuiteCRM. It is specific to the module's handling of campaign prospect relationships.

classes.name: ProspectLink
classes.description: A class extending Link2 that customizes join behavior for campaign prospect relationships in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to generate a customized SQL join clause for campaign target list relations, with specific handling for one-to-many relationships and different join types.
